title: 2026 offshore GHG regulatory-fee governance QA controls

sources.publisher: Offshore Petroleum Regulator for Environment and Decommissioning / DESNZ
sources.title: Oil and Gas: fees and charges
Environment Agency greenhouse gas emissions charging scheme 2026-27

facts.source_fact: OPRED performs environmental and other regulatory functions for offshore oil and gas, offshore gas storage and offshore carbon-dioxide storage activities.
facts.expected_handling: Apply offshore regulatory scope before using fee information.

facts.source_fact: Offshore regulatory fees are authorised through a mixture of charging schemes, activity-specific legislation and fees-specific legislation.
facts.expected_handling: Store the legal charging basis for each fee.

facts.source_fact: The principal fees-specific 2015 Regulations were most recently amended on 7 July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Version fee-law references to the current amendment date.

facts.source_fact: Time spent on chargeable functions is recorded for fee calculation.
facts.expected_handling: Treat time-recording as charging governance, not emissions measurement.

facts.source_fact: Fees use an hourly rate for environmental specialist staff.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve staff-rate category in fee calculations.

facts.source_fact: Fees use a separate hourly rate for non-specialist staff.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve staff-rate category in fee calculations.

facts.source_fact: The Pollution Prevention and Control Fees Miscellaneous Amendments Regulations 2026 came into force on 7 July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach effective date before calculating charges.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 fee amendments include functions under Part 4A of the Energy Act 2008.
facts.expected_handling: Carry legal-regime identity with the charge.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 fee amendments include functions under the Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009.
facts.expected_handling: Keep marine-licensing charges separate from GHG scheme charges.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 fee amendments include Energy Savings Opportunity Scheme regulatory functions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not merge ESOS charges with emissions-trading charges.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 amendments cover specified offshore-safety regulatory functions.
facts.expected_handling: Keep safety and environmental charging regimes distinct.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 amendments cover relevant fluorinated-gas regulatory functions.
facts.expected_handling: Carry F-gas legal basis separately from UK ETS.

facts.source_fact: The Greenhouse Gas Emissions Trading Scheme Regulations 2012 charging scheme was revised to align with the 2026 fee arrangements.
facts.expected_handling: Version the 2012-scheme charging document to 7 July 2026.

facts.source_fact: The Offshore Combustion Installations Regulations 2013 charging scheme was revised with the 2026 fee arrangements.
facts.expected_handling: Keep combustion-permit charging distinct from allowance-market costs.

facts.source_fact: The Greenhouse Gas Emissions Trading Scheme Order 2020 charging scheme was revised with effect from 7 July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Use the current charging-scheme vintage.

facts.source_fact: The Offshore Chemicals Regulations 2002 charging scheme was revised for 7 July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Separate chemical-regulation fees from GHG fees.

facts.source_fact: The offshore oil-pollution charging scheme was revised for 7 July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Separate oil-pollution fees from GHG fees.

facts.source_fact: The Oil and Gas fees page was updated on 9 July 2026 following the new fee arrangements.
facts.expected_handling: Store page-vintage provenance.

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency GHG charging scheme applies from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027 for its stated regulated activities.
facts.expected_handling: Use charge-year boundaries for England-regulated activities.

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency 2026-27 scheme added Part 3A maritime charges from July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Apply maritime charging only from its effective scheme date.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve fee-law and scheme facts without broadening scope.
Attach regulator, offshore/onshore regime and chargeable function.
Attach fee-year and 7 July 2026 amendment/effective dates.
Carry legal basis, staff-rate category and charging-scheme provenance.
Do not convert regulatory charges into parcel-level measured emissions.
